references.text: The Kohathites were responsible for the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, and the holy utensils used in the service.
Describes the service of Kohah's sons with the most holy things, which they had to carry.
Kohah's sons were to come and carry the holy objects after Aaron and his sons had covered them.
Warning that the Kohathites must not look at the holy things, and that the priests were to assign each man his task.
The poles for the ark were to be inserted into the rings in order to carry it.
Bezalel made poles to carry the ark with.
The Levites who carried the Lord's ark of the covenant are mentioned here.
The Levitical priests carried the Lord's ark of the covenant.
When those carrying the Lord's ark had gone six steps, David offered a sacrifice.
David said that no one other than the Levites should carry God's ark, for the Lord had chosen them for this task.
The Levites carried God's ark with poles on their shoulders, as Moses had commanded according to the word of the Lord.
